notices.title: Has the VR Hype Finally Passed
notices.contentSnippet: Virtual Reality has been touted as the future for longer than most of us have been alive, so at what point does it just become a relic of the past?  VR has had it's ups and downs, but in the end it's never hit the mainstream.  Today, we are going to look at the life cycles of Virtual Reality, where it stands now, and if the "future of gaming" actually has a future worth noting.
